[English]
​Hi everyone, I'm new here! I wanted to try out the game, so I downloaded the mobile version and signed up using my Google account.

​However, after downloading all the game resources and tapping "Enter Mythag", I got a pop-up saying "You have reached the maximum numbers of characters allowed" and I can't progress any further.

​I searched online and found out this usually happens when you reroll (reset) too many times, but I swear today is literally my first time playing and I haven't rerolled even once.

​Has anyone experienced this or knows how to fix it? Any help would be greatly appreciated!

​[中文]
大家好，我是新玩家！很想体验这款游戏，所以下载了手机版，并用 Google 账号进行了注册。
​但是在下载完所有资源、点击“进入密斯卡托尼克大学”之后，弹出了 “角色创建数量已达上限” 的提示，没办法进行下一步。
​我上网查了一下，听说频繁重刷（刷初始）可能会出现这种情况。但我发誓今天真的是我第一次玩，一次都没有重刷过。
​请问有人遇到过这种情况或者知道怎么解决吗？非常感谢大家的帮助！

I'm aware there are people who likes Traphase. I am not one of them. 150 cards per season just feels like a drain to play through. The fact that it's a decently significant amount of silver and core rewards only compounds the issue.

My suggestion is to either move the silver and cores rewards to some other channel, or if it's important to have an incentive to get new players to try out the game mode, at least keep it light, such as 1 match played or just about 20~30 cards played. People who already like the game mode won't need the incentive. People who dislike it are just going to feel like it's a burden.

Another benefit to keeping the requirements light is that you can quickly filter out all the people in the matching pool who are just there for the rewards instead of caring about proper matches (that's me). Well, unless you're really really desperate to have people playing Traphase.
Request - Please lighten the requirement for the seasonal Silver rewards for Traphase

Anything that makes me play less Traphase would improve my gaming experience.

Even better if we managed to completely skip PVP playing bots, or had a PVE alternative, but well... One can only dream...

Used to be 5 wins requirement.

Look just slap on a Jenkin that spams cards if you want to get It over with.

1 - I do not have Jenkin. That means I can't do that in All Pick, and neither is the option always available in Draft Pick. 
2 - People who don't like this game mode might not even be familiar enough with the kits to know who to use for card spam.
3 - Why should this measure (choosing a particular character/playing a specific way) even be necessary? Just because it used to be worse doesn't mean we should settle for the status quo.

In fact I'm surprised this idea is this contested. I would have thought that people who don't like Traphase would agree with me, while people who do would be neutral on it. I'm not even advocating for less rewards. Everyone's still getting the silver and cores, just easier.

I'm on the other side of this so I'll leave my thoughts since you're surprised it's contested. I like having things to engage with every week. If the only thing that resets on a given week is a mode that theoretically requires one match to get stuff, I might just not play that week at all. I usually use Honkai Star Rail as an example. Every patch people are like "we want this easier, we want that faster etc. etc.", and now there's literally nothing to do during a patch at all. People log in maybe 3 days out of a 40 day patch cycle because EVERY event or resettable gamemode can be autoed or AFKed through in less than an hour. I WANT to play the game and be challenged by the game, and just having Dtide once every two weeks isn't really enough. Weekly seasonal missions that actually let me engage with the game give me a reason to not just stop playing and then potentially drop the game because there's not enough to do
there is a big content drought in the game. and pvp wont help fix it imo

If they added something else to the cycle along with cutting the traphase mission down that would be acceptable, but just cutting stuff without giving any other reason to play that week will just lose the game players

I feel like this is a bit subjective though. It's not reasonable to expect there to be enough content to entirely dominate your schedule every month, NO gacha game can do that, no studio has the resources for that. That's what the weekly rotating content is for though. Star Rail is a drought, not having anything to do for over a month at a time is a drought. Unless this game had some kind of daily resettable content I'm not sure what else they should do to not feel droughty. They could have every seasonal mode reset every week and cut the rewards of each but that might overwhelm some people. Star Rail adds slop events but would anyone playing this game enjoy them adding an AFK Tetris gamemode with an hour of gameplay and calling it new content? That's what Star Rail got this patch a couple days ago XD

playing d-tide for 2 hours evert 2 weeks and nothing else to do... if it is not a drought, well, I do not know how to call it. The game needs more pve modes, like tower mode which was discussed in another thread.

Yeah, I guess if you don't do Pdive or Train or Traphase and only do d-tide it could feel droughty. I do think there's more room for additional PvE modes with different mechanics, but I don't think the current setup is that restrictive

But unless you've whaled very specific characters I'd be very surprised if you're just getting perfect runs on Train and Pdive when they reset. I feel like they're difficult enough that you should have to spend some time playing them to get leaderboard rewards. Maybe not train if you get lucky and 3k the first run you do, but Pdive for sure. And choosing not to engage with Traphase is a choice, PvP content is inherently the best way to have a gamemode that doesn't get stale fast, you're playing against other people that make their own choices, and it's not P2W, they try to keep it balanced so that the matches are fair

I see what you mean, but it rests on the premise that you do like the content, at least enough to engage with it. To those who don't like it, yes, not engaging with the mode is a choice (probably what I'll do once I get truly tired), but the problem is that those seasonal rewards are rather significant. Just the cores alone are already 10 standard pulls over the 2 modes, and the silver is worth 2.5 limited pulls. This means over time there'd be a growing gulf between people who engages in the mode vs people who don't.

From what I see, the problem here is that rewards that are used in the standard game mode are coupled with a game mode that is both much too different from the standard pve mode and also barely affected by your main game progress. Only your unlocked characters and wheels affect Traphase - and only one mode of Traphase too, at that. None of your other spent resources mean anything: not your character levels, not enlightens, not skills, etc. This makes it an entirely different game, and it should be treated as such, not forcefully linked to the main game by means of only the silver and core rewards.

If you're not in favor of just lowering the barrier to the premium currency rewards as it is, then I can only think of two other options: 
1 - swap the seasonal rewards for something less essential, such as scrips/xp/skill mats, while the silver and cores are distributed some other way that's more accessible to everyone.
2 - create an entirely new ecosystem for Traphase, with separate currencies and resources. With proper design, this should hopefully be attractive enough to the mode's fans while not making people who don't like it feel like they're missing out. The old silver and core rewards can still stay as a quick introduction to the mode, like a 1 match participation reward.
